import math

int integer_value(string text)
    return int(text)

string clock_text(int minute)
    return "{minute / 1440 + 1}-{minute % 1440 / 60:02.}:{minute % 60:02.}"

string duration(int minute)
    return "{minute / 60}:{minute % 60:02.}"

string tenth(int value)
    return "{value / 10}.{value % 10}"

string type_name(int kind)
    return ["MOTORCYCLE", "CAR", "ECAR", "VAN", "BUS"][kind]

string spot_kind(int kind)
    return ["MOTO", "COMPACT", "LARGE", "EV"][kind]

int type_id(string text)
    for: 0 <= k < 5
        if text == type_name(k)
            return k
    return -1

int[] preference(int kind)
    if kind == 0
        return [0, 1, 2]
    if kind == 1
        return [1, 2]
    if kind == 2
        return [3, 1, 2]
    return [2]

int preference_rank(int kind, int target)
    kinds := preference(kind)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#kinds)
        if kinds[k] == target
            return k
    return -1

class Spot(int level, int number, int kind, bool closed, int occupant)
class Vehicle(string plate, int kind, int spot, int entered, int energy, int charging, int validation, int paid_at, int paid_parking, int paid_night, bool active, int exited, string exit_location, int total, bool lost)
class Waiting(string plate, int kind, int joined)
class Pass(string plate, int last_day)
class State()
    now := 0
    levels := 0
    Spot[] spots := []
    vehicles := array(1000, fill = Vehicle("", 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0, false, -1, "", 0, false))
    vehicle_used := 0
    exits := array(1000, fill = 0)
    exit_used := 0
    Waiting[] waiting := []
    Pass[] passes := []
    rates := [100, 200, 200, 300, 600]
    caps := [800, 1600, 1600, 2400, 4800]
    fees := [300, 2000, 30]
    int[][] stats := array(5, fill = array(4, fill = 0))
    int[][] revenue := array(5, fill = array(6, fill = 0))
    int[][][] daily := array(61, fill = array(5, fill = array(4, fill = 0)))
    parked := 0
    peak := 0
    peak_at := -1

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string text)
    emit("ERROR " + text)

string spot_text(const State state, int index)
    item := state.spots[index]
    return "L" + string(item.level) + "-" + string(item.number)

string location(const State state, int index)
    item := state.vehicles[index]
    result := spot_text(state, item.spot)
    if item.kind == 4
        result += ".." + string(state.spots[item.spot].number + 2)
    return result

int parked_id(const State state, string plate)
    for: 0 <= k < state.vehicle_used
        if state.vehicles[k].active and state.vehicles[k].plate == plate
            return k
    return -1

int waiting_id(const State state, string plate)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.waiting)
        if state.waiting[k].plate == plate
            return k
    return -1

int pass_id(const State state, string plate)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.passes)
        if state.passes[k].plate == plate
            return k
    return -1

bool valid_pass(const State state, string plate, int minute)
    index := pass_id(state, plate)
    return index >= 0 and state.passes[index].last_day >= minute / 1440 + 1

int spot_id(const State state, string text)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots)
        if spot_text(state, k) == text
            return k
    return -1

bool free_spot(const State state, int index)
    return not state.spots[index].closed and state.spots[index].occupant < 0

int assign_spot(const State state, int kind)
    if kind == 4
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots) - 2
            fits := true
            for: 0 <= offset < 3
                item := state.spots[k + offset]
                if item.level != state.spots[k].level or item.number != state.spots[k].number + offset or item.kind != 2 or not free_spot(state, k + offset)
                    fits = false
            if fits
                return k
    else
        for target := preference(kind)[]
            for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots)
                if state.spots[k].kind == target and free_spot(state, k)
                    return k
    return -1

int[] location_order(const State state)
    int[] result := []
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots)
        index := state.spots[k].occupant
        if index >= 0 and state.vehicles[index].spot == k
            result = result.append(index)
    return result

void occupy(State &state, int index, int target)
    state.vehicles[index].spot = target
    for: 0 <= offset < (if state.vehicles[index].kind == 4 then 3 else 1)
        state.spots[target + offset].occupant = index

void vacate(State &state, int index)
    target := state.vehicles[index].spot
    for: 0 <= offset < (if state.vehicles[index].kind == 4 then 3 else 1)
        state.spots[target + offset].occupant = -1

int admit(State &state, string plate, int kind, int target)
    index := state.vehicle_used
    state.vehicle_used += 1
    state.vehicles[index] = Vehicle(plate, kind, target, state.now, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0, true, -1, "", 0, false)
    occupy(&state, index, target)
    state.stats[kind][0] += 1
    state.daily[state.now / 1440 + 1][kind][0] += 1
    state.parked += 1
    if state.parked > state.peak
        state.peak = state.parked
        state.peak_at = state.now
    return index

void refusal(State &state, int kind, int minute)
    state.stats[kind][2] += 1
    state.daily[minute / 1440 + 1][kind][2] += 1

void give_up(State &state)
    Waiting[] remaining := []
    for item := state.waiting[]
        if state.now - item.joined >= 30
            emit("GIVEUP " + item.plate + " " + type_name(item.kind) + " " + clock_text(item.joined + 30))
            refusal(&state, item.kind, item.joined + 30)
        else
            remaining = remaining.append(item)
    state.waiting = remaining

void process_queue(State &state)
    Waiting[] remaining := []
    for item := state.waiting[]
        target := assign_spot(state, item.kind)
        if target < 0
            remaining = remaining.append(item)
        else
            index := admit(&state, item.plate, item.kind, target)
            emit("ADMIT " + item.plate + " " + type_name(item.kind) + " " + location(state, index) + " waited " + duration(state.now - item.joined))
    state.waiting = remaining

int[] interval_fee(const State state, int index, int start, int finish, int free_minutes)
    item := state.vehicles[index]
    stay := finish - start
    if valid_pass(state, item.plate, finish) or stay <= free_minutes
        return [0, 0]
    parking := 0
    offset := 0
    while offset < stay
        minutes := math.min(1440, stay - offset)
        if offset == 0
            minutes -= free_minutes
        parking += math.min((minutes + 29) / 30 * state.rates[item.kind], state.caps[item.kind])
        offset += 1440
    return [parking, (finish / 1440 - start / 1440) * state.fees[0]]

int[] exit_fees(const State state, int index, bool lost)
    item := state.vehicles[index]
    amounts := array(6, fill = 0)
    if item.paid_at < 0
        partial := interval_fee(state, index, item.entered, state.now, 15 + item.validation)
        amounts[0] = partial[0]
        amounts[1] = partial[1]
        amounts[2] = if lost then state.fees[1] else 0
        amounts[5] = amounts[0] + amounts[1] + amounts[2] + item.charging
    else
        extra := interval_fee(state, index, item.paid_at, state.now, 15)
        amounts[0] = item.paid_parking + extra[0]
        amounts[1] = item.paid_night + extra[1]
        amounts[5] = extra[0] + extra[1]
    amounts[3] = item.charging
    amounts[4] = amounts[:<4].sum()
    return amounts

void fee_line(const State state, int index, string label, int[] amounts)
    item := state.vehicles[index]
    emit(label + " " + item.plate + " " + location(state, index) + " stay " + duration(state.now - item.entered) + " parking " + string(amounts[0]) + " night " + string(amounts[1]) + " lost " + string(amounts[2]) + " charge " + string(amounts[3]) + " total " + string(amounts[4]) + " due " + string(amounts[5]))

string annotation(const State state, int index)
    item := state.vehicles[index]
    result := ""
    if valid_pass(state, item.plate, state.now)
        result += " PASS"
    if item.validation > 0
        result += " VAL " + string(item.validation)
    if item.energy > 0
        result += " KWH " + string(item.energy)
    if item.paid_at >= 0
        result += " PAID"
    return result

void move_vehicle(State &state, int index, int target)
    previous := location(state, index)
    vacate(&state, index)
    occupy(&state, index, target)
    emit("MOVE " + state.vehicles[index].plate + " " + previous + " -> " + location(state, index))

string occupancy_line(string label, int[] used, int[] available, int closed_count)
    result := label
    for: 0 <= k < 4
        result += " " + spot_kind(k) + " " + string(used[k]) + "/" + string(available[k])
    return result + " closed " + string(closed_count)

string daily_fields(int[] values)
    return " entries " + string(values[0]) + " exits " + string(values[1]) + " refused " + string(values[2]) + " revenue " + string(values[3])

string stats_fields(int[] values)
    average := if values[1] == 0 then 0 else values[3] * 10 / values[1]
    return " entries " + string(values[0]) + " exits " + string(values[1]) + " refused " + string(values[2]) + " avg_stay " + tenth(average)

string revenue_fields(int[] values)
    return " exits " + string(values[0]) + " parking " + string(values[1]) + " night " + string(values[2]) + " lost " + string(values[3]) + " charge " + string(values[4]) + " total " + string(values[5])

void command(State &state, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    clock := words[1].split(":")
    state.now = (integer_value(words[0]) - 1) * 1440 + integer_value(clock[0]) * 60 + integer_value(clock[1])
    give_up(&state)
    action := words[2]
    if action == "LEVEL"
        state.levels += 1
        total := 0
        result := ""
        for: 0 <= kind < 4
            count := integer_value(words[kind + 3])
            result += " " + spot_kind(kind) + " " + string(count)
            for: 0 <= k < count
                total += 1
                state.spots = state.spots.append(Spot(state.levels, total, kind, false, -1))
        emit("LEVEL " + string(state.levels) + " spots " + string(total) + result)
        process_queue(&state)
        return
    if action == "CLOSE" or action == "OPEN"
        target := spot_id(state, words[3])
        if target < 0
            fail("unknown spot " + words[3])
        elif action == "CLOSE" and state.spots[target].closed
            fail("spot " + words[3] + " is already closed")
        elif action == "OPEN" and not state.spots[target].closed
            fail("spot " + words[3] + " is not closed")
        elif action == "CLOSE" and state.spots[target].occupant >= 0
            fail("spot " + words[3] + " is occupied by " + state.vehicles[state.spots[target].occupant].plate)
        else
            state.spots[target].closed = action == "CLOSE"
            emit(action + " " + words[3] + " " + spot_kind(state.spots[target].kind))
            if action == "OPEN"
                process_queue(&state)
        return
    if action == "RATE" or action == "FEE"
        if action == "RATE"
            kind := type_id(words[3])
            rate := integer_value(words[4])
            cap := integer_value(words[5])
            if kind < 0
                fail("unknown type " + words[3])
            elif cap < rate
                fail("cap below rate for " + words[3])
            else
                state.rates[kind] = rate
                state.caps[kind] = cap
                emit("RATE " + words[3] + " " + string(rate) + " " + string(cap))
        else
            item := -1
            kinds := ["NIGHT", "LOST", "KWH"]
            for: 0 <= k < 3
                if words[3] == kinds[k]
                    item = k
            if item < 0
                fail("unknown fee " + words[3])
            else
                state.fees[item] = integer_value(words[4])
                emit("FEE " + words[3] + " " + string(state.fees[item]))
        return
    if action == "ENTER"
        plate := words[3]
        kind := type_id(words[4])
        index := parked_id(state, plate)
        queued := waiting_id(state, plate)
        if kind < 0
            fail("unknown type " + words[4])
        elif index >= 0
            fail(plate + " is already parked at " + location(state, index))
        elif queued >= 0
            fail(plate + " is already waiting")
        else
            target := assign_spot(state, kind)
            if target >= 0
                admitted := admit(&state, plate, kind, target)
                emit("ENTER " + plate + " " + type_name(kind) + " " + location(state, admitted))
            elif #state.waiting < 3
                state.waiting = state.waiting.append(Waiting(plate, kind, state.now))
                emit("WAIT " + plate + " " + type_name(kind) + " " + string(#state.waiting))
            else
                refusal(&state, kind, state.now)
                emit("FULL " + plate + " " + type_name(kind))
        return
    if action == "LEAVE"
        queued := waiting_id(state, words[3])
        if queued < 0
            fail(words[3] + " is not waiting")
        else
            emit("LEAVE " + words[3] + " " + type_name(state.waiting[queued].kind))
            state.waiting = state.waiting[:<queued].concat(state.waiting[queued + 1:])
        return
    if action == "PASS" or action == "UNPASS"
        index := pass_id(state, words[3])
        valid := valid_pass(state, words[3], state.now)
        if action == "UNPASS"
            if not valid
                fail(words[3] + " has no pass")
            else
                state.passes[index].last_day = 0
                emit("UNPASS " + words[3])
        else
            days := integer_value(words[4])
            deadline := (if valid then state.passes[index].last_day else state.now / 1440) + days
            if index < 0
                state.passes = state.passes.append(Pass(words[3], deadline))
            else
                state.passes[index].last_day = deadline
            emit("PASS " + words[3] + " until " + string(deadline))
        return
    if action == "EXIT" or action == "PAY" or action == "QUOTE" or action == "CHARGE" or action == "VALIDATE" or action == "MOVE"
        plate := words[3]
        index := parked_id(state, plate)
        if index < 0
            fail(plate + " is not parked")
            return
        item := state.vehicles[index]
        if action == "MOVE"
            target := spot_id(state, words[4])
            if item.kind == 4
                fail("bus " + plate + " cannot be moved")
            elif target < 0
                fail("unknown spot " + words[4])
            elif item.spot == target
                fail(plate + " is already at " + words[4])
            elif state.spots[target].closed
                fail("spot " + words[4] + " is closed")
            elif state.spots[target].occupant >= 0
                fail("spot " + words[4] + " is occupied by " + state.vehicles[state.spots[target].occupant].plate)
            elif preference_rank(item.kind, state.spots[target].kind) < 0
                fail(type_name(item.kind) + " cannot use " + spot_kind(state.spots[target].kind) + " spot " + words[4])
            else
                move_vehicle(&state, index, target)
                process_queue(&state)
            return
        if action == "CHARGE"
            energy := integer_value(words[4])
            if item.kind != 2
                fail(plate + " is not an electric car")
            elif state.spots[item.spot].kind != 3
                fail(plate + " is not at a charger")
            elif item.paid_at >= 0
                fail(plate + " has already paid")
            elif item.energy + energy > 100
                fail("charge limit exceeded for " + plate)
            else
                int cost := energy * state.fees[2]
                state.vehicles[index].energy += energy
                state.vehicles[index].charging += cost
                emit("CHARGE " + plate + " kwh " + string(energy) + " cost " + string(cost) + " stay_kwh " + string(state.vehicles[index].energy) + " stay_cost " + string(state.vehicles[index].charging))
            return
        if action == "VALIDATE"
            minutes := integer_value(words[4])
            if item.paid_at >= 0
                fail(plate + " has already paid")
            elif item.validation + minutes > 180
                fail("validation limit exceeded for " + plate)
            else
                state.vehicles[index].validation += minutes
                emit("VALIDATE " + plate + " " + string(minutes) + " total " + string(state.vehicles[index].validation))
            return
        lost := action == "EXIT" and #words == 5
        if item.paid_at >= 0 and (action == "PAY" or lost)
            fail(plate + " has already paid")
            return
        amounts := exit_fees(state, index, lost)
        if action == "PAY"
            state.vehicles[index].paid_at = state.now
            state.vehicles[index].paid_parking = amounts[0]
            state.vehicles[index].paid_night = amounts[1]
            emit("PAY " + plate + " parking " + string(amounts[0]) + " night " + string(amounts[1]) + " charge " + string(amounts[3]) + " total " + string(amounts[4]))
        else
            fee_line(state, index, action, amounts)
            if action == "EXIT"
                state.vehicles[index].exit_location = location(state, index)
                state.vehicles[index].exited = state.now
                state.vehicles[index].total = amounts[4]
                state.vehicles[index].lost = lost
                state.vehicles[index].active = false
                state.exits[state.exit_used] = index
                state.exit_used += 1
                vacate(&state, index)
                state.parked -= 1
                state.stats[item.kind][1] += 1
                state.stats[item.kind][3] += state.now - item.entered
                state.daily[state.now / 1440 + 1][item.kind][1] += 1
                state.daily[state.now / 1440 + 1][item.kind][3] += amounts[4]
                state.revenue[item.kind][0] += 1
                for: 0 <= k < 5
                    state.revenue[item.kind][k + 1] += amounts[k]
                process_queue(&state)
        return
    if action == "REBALANCE"
        moved := 0
        snapshot := location_order(state)
        for index := snapshot[]
            item := state.vehicles[index]
            if item.kind != 4 and preference_rank(item.kind, state.spots[item.spot].kind) > 0
                target := assign_spot(state, item.kind)
                if target >= 0 and preference_rank(item.kind, state.spots[target].kind) < preference_rank(item.kind, state.spots[item.spot].kind)
                    move_vehicle(&state, index, target)
                    moved += 1
        emit("REBALANCE " + string(moved))
        process_queue(&state)
    elif action == "WHERE"
        plate := words[3]
        index := parked_id(state, plate)
        queued := waiting_id(state, plate)
        last := -1
        for: 0 <= k < state.exit_used
            if state.vehicles[state.exits[k]].plate == plate
                last = state.exits[k]
        if index >= 0
            item := state.vehicles[index]
            emit("WHERE " + plate + " " + location(state, index) + " " + type_name(item.kind) + " " + clock_text(item.entered) + " stay " + duration(state.now - item.entered) + annotation(state, index))
        elif queued >= 0
            emit("WHERE " + plate + " waiting " + string(queued + 1))
        elif last >= 0
            emit("WHERE " + plate + " gone " + clock_text(state.vehicles[last].exited))
        else
            fail("unknown plate " + plate)
    elif action == "LIST" or action == "OVERSTAY"
        level := if action == "LIST" and #words == 4 then integer_value(words[3]) else 0
        if level > state.levels
            fail("unknown level " + string(level))
            return
        hours := if action == "OVERSTAY" then integer_value(words[3]) else 0
        int[] found := []
        for index := location_order(state)[]
            item := state.vehicles[index]
            if (level == 0 or state.spots[item.spot].level == level) and state.now - item.entered >= hours * 60
                found = found.append(index)
        if action == "OVERSTAY"
            for: 1 <= k < int(#found)
                index := found[k]
                position := k
                while position > 0 and state.vehicles[found[position - 1]].entered > state.vehicles[index].entered
                    found[position] = found[position - 1]
                    position -= 1
                found[position] = index
        emit(action + (if action == "OVERSTAY" then " " + string(hours) else "") + " " + string(#found))
        for index := found[]
            item := state.vehicles[index]
            text := location(state, index) + " " + item.plate + " " + type_name(item.kind) + " " + clock_text(item.entered)
            emit(text + (if action == "OVERSTAY" then " stay " + duration(state.now - item.entered) else annotation(state, index)))
    elif action == "MAP"
        emit("MAP " + string(state.levels))
        for: 1 <= level <= state.levels
            symbols := ""
            count := 0
            for item := state.spots[]
                if item.level == level
                    if count > 0 and count % 10 == 0
                        symbols += " "
                    symbols += if item.closed then "#" elif item.occupant >= 0 then "MCLE"[item.kind] else "mcle"[item.kind]
                    count += 1
            emit("L" + string(level) + " " + symbols)
    elif action == "OCCUPANCY"
        emit("OCCUPANCY vehicles " + string(state.parked) + " waiting " + string(#state.waiting))
        all_used := array(4, fill = 0)
        all_available := array(4, fill = 0)
        all_closed := 0
        for: 1 <= level <= state.levels
            used := array(4, fill = 0)
            available := array(4, fill = 0)
            closed_count := 0
            for item := state.spots[]
                if item.level == level
                    if item.closed
                        closed_count += 1
                    else
                        available[item.kind] += 1
                        if item.occupant >= 0
                            used[item.kind] += 1
            emit(occupancy_line("L" + string(level), used, available, closed_count))
            all_used += used
            all_available += available
            all_closed += closed_count
        numerator := all_used.sum()
        denominator := all_available.sum()
        usage := if denominator == 0 then 0 else numerator * 1000 / denominator
        emit(occupancy_line("TOTAL", all_used, all_available, all_closed) + " rate " + tenth(usage) + "%")
    elif action == "SIGN"
        spaces := array(5, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= kind < 4
            for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots)
                if free_spot(state, k) and preference_rank(kind, state.spots[k].kind) >= 0
                    spaces[kind] += 1
        run := 0
        previous_level := 0
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.spots)
            item := state.spots[k]
            if item.level != previous_level or item.kind != 2 or not free_spot(state, k)
                spaces[4] += run / 3
                run = 0
            if item.kind == 2 and free_spot(state, k)
                run += 1
            previous_level = item.level
        spaces[4] += run / 3
        text := "SIGN"
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            text += " " + type_name(k) + " " + (if spaces[k] == 0 then "FULL" else string(spaces[k]))
        emit(text)
    elif action == "RATES"
        emit("RATES")
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            emit(type_name(k) + " " + string(state.rates[k]) + " " + string(state.caps[k]))
        emit("NIGHT " + string(state.fees[0]) + " LOST " + string(state.fees[1]) + " KWH " + string(state.fees[2]))
    elif action == "PASSES"
        plates := [for item := state.passes[] if item.last_day >= state.now / 1440 + 1 then item.plate]
        plates = plates.sorted()
        emit("PASSES " + string(#plates))
        for plate := plates[]
            index := pass_id(state, plate)
            emit(plate + " until " + string(state.passes[index].last_day) + (if parked_id(state, plate) >= 0 then " IN" else ""))
    elif action == "HISTORY"
        int[] found := []
        total := 0
        for: 0 <= k < state.exit_used
            int index := state.exits[k]
            if state.vehicles[index].plate == words[3]
                found = found.append(index)
                total += state.vehicles[index].total
        if #found == 0
            fail("no history for " + words[3])
        else
            emit("HISTORY " + words[3] + " visits " + string(#found) + " paid " + string(total))
            for index := found[]
                item := state.vehicles[index]
                emit(clock_text(item.entered) + " " + clock_text(item.exited) + " " + item.exit_location + " " + type_name(item.kind) + " " + string(item.total) + (if item.lost then " LOST" else ""))
    elif action == "REVENUE"
        emit("REVENUE")
        total := array(6, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            emit(type_name(k) + revenue_fields(state.revenue[k]))
            total += state.revenue[k]
        emit("TOTAL" + revenue_fields(total))
    elif action == "DAILY"
        date := integer_value(words[3])
        int[][] values := if date <= 60 then state.daily[date] else array(5, fill = array(4, fill = 0))
        total := array(4, fill = 0)
        for item := values[]
            total += item
        emit("DAILY " + string(date) + daily_fields(total))
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            emit(type_name(k) + daily_fields(values[k]))
    else
        emit("STATS parked " + string(state.parked) + " peak " + string(state.peak) + " at " + (if state.peak_at < 0 then "-" else clock_text(state.peak_at)))
        total := array(4, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            emit(type_name(k) + stats_fields(state.stats[k]))
            total += state.stats[k]
        emit("ALL" + stats_fields(total))

command_count := 0
scan(&command_count)
garage := State()
for: 0 <= line_number < command_count
    input_line := ""
    scan(&input_line)
    command(&garage, input_line)
